aiTexts: The Intex Inflatable Shark Whale Ride-on Swim Ring is easy to inflate, allowing quick setup for water fun.
Made with high-quality materials, it ensures safety and comfort for all users.
Suitable for children and adults, it works well in pools, lakes, and oceans to enhance water safety.
Its durable inflatable design supports long-lasting use.
Featuring playful shark and whale shapes, it adds excitement to swimming activities.

product.desc:
Easy to Inflate

With its easy-to-inflate design, setting up this swimming ring is a breeze, allowing you to enjoy the water activities sooner.

Safety First

Designed with safety in mind, these swimming rings are made from high-quality materials, ensuring a safe and comfortable experience for all users.

Versatile Use

Ideal for both children and adults, these swimming rings can be used in various water settings, including pools, lakes, and oceans, enhancing water safety and enjoyment.

Inflatable Design

The Intex surfing swimming ring features an inflatable design, providing durability and longevity for endless fun in the water.

Shark and Whale Shapes

Available in shark and whale shapes, these swimming rings add a fun and playful element to your pool, making swimming more enjoyable for kids and adults alike.

title: GWYNET | Inflatable Floating Bed Swimming Ring Water Toy
detail_text: Easy to Use With its simple inflating process, this floating circle is easy to use, making it perfect for beginners or children learning to swim. Versatile Use This floating circle can be used as a swimming chair, providing support and comfort while enjoying the water, making it ideal for pool parties or beach outings. Diverse Age Group Designed for both adults and children, this floating bed offers fun and relaxation for people of all ages. Inflatable Design The swimming floating bed is designed with an inflatable structure, providing a comfortable and durable experience for both adults and children. Safety Feature Equipped with safety valves, this floating bed ensures proper inflation and deflation, enhancing user safety during use.

Easy to Use



With its simple inflating process, this floating circle is easy to use, making it perfect for beginners or children learning to swim.






Versatile Use



This floating circle can be used as a swimming chair, providing support and comfort while enjoying the water, making it ideal for pool parties or beach outings.






Diverse Age Group

Inflatable Design

Safety Feature



Equipped with safety valves, this floating bed ensures proper inflation and deflation, enhancing user safety during use.

title: BigMouth Inc Glitter Rainbow Cloud Pool Float
detail_text: about product Brighten up your summer break! When you're on summer vacation you truly feel like you're on Cloud 9, am I right? We pulled that oh-so-good feeling down into the pool so you can float on it! If you want to add a splash of color to the pool party, beach trip, or lake excursion, this is your ray of sunshine. The thick, durable vinyl keeps you floating all summer long, and you don't have to weather a thunderstorm to see a rainbow. To take your mood up into the stratosphere, we infused the cloud with bold, colorful glitter so that when it's in the sunlight, it shimmers like your personality. Over 4 feet wide! Sized right for big fun in any size pool. Infused with colorful glitter sprinkles inside. Standard air valve. Great for pool parties, beach days, and vacations. Easy to wipe down, inflate/deflate, and store. Approx inflated dimensions: 47 x 48.5 x 40 inches.

title: Swim Vest for Toddlers & Kids, Neoprene Swimming Aid Vest with Removable Floatation Pads, Adjustable Safety Strap & Secure Zip, Toddler Swim Trainer Floaties for Boys Girls 2-9 Years
detail_text: Adjustable Buoyancy for Confidence: Our toddler swim vest is designed to help kids learn at their own pace with adjustable buoyancy. Featuring 8 removable floats, this swim vest for toddlers allows you to customize support as water confidence grows. Perfect for pool swimming, swim lessons, and beach play, it promotes natural swim training without over-reliance. Premium Neoprene Comfort: Crafted from soft and flexible neoprene fabric, our baby swim vest provides sun-safe comfort for delicate skin. Unlike stiff alternatives, this kids swim vest ensures full arm and leg movement, allowing your little ones to splash and kick freely without chafing during water activities. Secure Fit for Natural Posture: Designed to maintain a stable and upright position, our infant swim vest includes an adjustable crotch strap with a safety buckle that prevents riding up. This ergonomic design promotes a natural swimming posture, enabling kids to practice essential water safety skills while enjoying the fun in pools or lakes. Parent-Friendly Easy On/Off: Getting ready for water adventures is hassle-free with our swim vest toddler design. The full front zipper and hook-and-loop closure allow for quick dressing, while the adjustable crotch strap and quick-release buckle ensure a secure fit that remains in place during active water play. Durable reinforced stitching makes it perfect for daily summer fun. Bright Colors & Certified Safety: Ensure visibility with high-visibility colors in our kids swimming vest, making it easy to spot your child in crowded water parks or beaches. This swim vest meets CE certification standards for supervised water activities and is made from quick-dry fabric resistant to chlorine damage—ideal for all your swimming adventures throughout the season.

product.desc:
ABOUT THE PRODUCT:

* Giant White Swan Inflatable Pool Float

This majestic Giant White Swan Float is perfect for both kids and adults, offering a stylish way to relax in the pool. With its oversized wings and elegant design, it adds a touch of luxury and fun to any summer gathering. Made from durable, high-quality material, it provides plenty of space for lounging, floating, or even hosting a poolside picnic. Ideal for pool parties, beach days, or simply relaxing in the sun.

* Giant Swan Inflatable Float for Summer Fun

Make a splash this summer with the Giant White Swan Inflatable Float. Designed for ultimate comfort, this float features a spacious seat for kids and adults alike. The classic white swan design, complete with graceful wings and a charming swan head, creates the perfect addition to your pool or beach adventures. It's made with sturdy materials, ensuring long-lasting fun and support for all your floating escapades.

* Oversized White Swan Inflatable Swimming Float

Experience ultimate relaxation on the water with the Giant White Swan Inflatable Float. This oversized float is designed for maximum comfort and fun, offering ample space for adults and kids to lounge or play. Whether you're hosting a pool party or enjoying a quiet day by the lake, this float’s whimsical design and sturdy construction make it a summer must-have. Its eye-catching swan shape makes it a standout at any outdoor gathering.

* Giant White Swan Pool Float for All Ages

Transform your summer pool parties with the Giant White Swan Inflatable Float. Ideal for kids and adults, this float features a fun, oversized swan design that combines elegance and playfulness. Its comfortable seat and stable construction ensure a safe and relaxing experience on the water. Perfect for lounging, playing games, or just soaking up the sun, this float adds a unique touch to any outdoor summer event.

* White Swan Giant Inflatable Float for Pool Parties

Bring whimsy and fun to your pool with the Giant White Swan Inflatable Float. This float is designed for both children and adults, offering a large, comfortable surface for floating in the sun. The charming white swan design, complete with a large swan neck and wings, creates a playful and eye-catching look. Crafted from durable materials, this float promises hours of relaxation and fun during your summer poolside adventures.

PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS:

Fully inflated dimension: 1.9m x 1.9m x 1.3m (approx)

Material: High density and harmless plastic

Color: as shown on pictures

Note: This is not a life saving device. Do not leave a child unattended while device is in use. 

Meets international standards including GB-6675 and EN-71

Please use repair patch in case of any air leak.

Happy Shopping!
